notices.title: EU Entry/Exit System (EES)
notices.text: Non-EU visitors are registered (fingerprints + photo) at the first Schengen border, and entries and exits are counted automatically, so overstaying the 90/180 limit will be detected.

notices.title: ETIAS travel authorisation
notices.text: Visa-free visitors are expected to need an ETIAS authorisation before travelling to the Schengen area. Check whether it is already required for your travel dates.
